technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot Test and JUnit 5 for writing acceptance tests.
Use Testcontainers for integration testing modules that require external systems like HDFS and Mail servers.
Use WireMock or embedded servers for testing HTTP-based or external dependencies where applicable.
Tests will be structured to run automatically as part of the CI pipeline.
Each module will have a dedicated test class covering its core functionality and edge cases.
assumptions: The existing modules (json-tuple, script, scripts, splitter, gauge, aggregate-counter, field-value-counter, hdfs-dataset, mail) are already implemented and available.
A CI pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) is already in place and can be configured to run the new tests.
Test infrastructure and base configurations for Spring Boot Test are partially available but may need minor adjustments.
Mocking external dependencies (HDFS, SMTP) is preferred over real external systems to keep CI execution fast and reliable.
Effort estimates represent pure development and testing time, excluding meetings and administrative overhead.

activities.activity_description: Configure the test environment, add necessary test dependencies (Testcontainers, WireMock, etc.), and ensure CI pipeline integration for the new acceptance tests.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the json-tuple processor module, covering standard input/output and edge cases.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance Tests for script and scripts Processors
activities.activity_description: Develop and verify acceptance tests for both the script and scripts processor modules, ensuring script execution and routing work as expected.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the splitter processor module, validating message splitting logic.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the gauge sink module, checking metric recording functionality.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the aggregate-counter sink module, validating aggregation logic.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the field-value-counter sink module, ensuring field value counting works correctly.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the hdfs-dataset sink module using Testcontainers to mock HDFS, validating dataset writing.
Develop and verify acceptance tests for the mail sink module using a mock SMTP server (e.g., GreenMail or Testcontainers), validating email sending logic.
Review all acceptance tests, ensure code coverage is adequate, fix any flaky tests, and finalize CI integration.
